verbatim_normalization:
Doc text conventions (the verbatim check normalizes whitespace on both sides):
- .xls (Globex holiday schedules): LibreOffice CSV export of every sheet, '|' separated,
  trailing '|' dropped per line; cells as LibreOffice displays them.
- .pdf: `pdftotext -layout` output.
- .json (trading-hours-by-product service): the raw response text (gunzipped if needed).
- .html: tags stripped (scripts/styles removed), entities unescaped.
- Confluence REST JSON: the page body (body.storage.value), then as .html.
Normalization: zero-width characters (U+200B-U+200D, U+FEFF) are deleted, then every run of
whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) becomes one space.
A quote may elide text with '...'; each elided segment must be a substring on its own.
